user.title: ThermoPilot
user.description: Select the meters and temperature sensors for the heat pump and building.

data.energy_entity: Heat pump – total electricity consumption (energy meter)

data_description.energy_entity: Select a cumulative energy meter for the heat pump's total electricity use. Unit can be Wh, kWh or MWh.
data_description.supply_entity: Sensor on the flow from the heat pump. Optional.
data_description.return_entity: Sensor on the return to the heat pump. Optional.
data_description.room_entities: Select room temperature sensors to include in the average. Optional.
data_description.thermostat_entities: Select thermal actuators or thermostats to count as active when their state is active. Optional.
data_description.degree_base: Reference temperature used by the model to calculate heating degree days. Defaults to 17 °C.
